newsitem.title: MONACO: SWIMMING-CAI, VOELKER MAKE UP FOR PANKRATOV WITHDRAWAL.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-CAI, VOELKER MAKE UP FOR PANKRATOV WITHDRAWAL.

text.p: Cai Huijue of China set a world best time and German Sandra Voelker a European record at the Monaco International swimming meeting on Saturday.
Their performances went a long way to compensating for the late withdrawal of Russia's double Olympic champion Denis Pankratov.
Cai, a member of China's bronze medal 4x100 metres medley team at last year's Atlanta Games, swam the 50 metres butterfly in 27.26 seconds.
Her compatriot Hong Qian set the previous mark of 27.30 in Perth, Australia in January 1991.
Voelker, also an Olympic bronze medal winner, set a European record of 29.00 when she swam the fastest 50 metres backstroke of the year.
She too ended a long reign by a comptariot. The previous record of 29.12 was set by Kristin Otto, of the former East Germany, in September 1988.

Pankratov, who was entered in the men's 50 metres backstroke, announced on Saturday morning he was pulling out of the meeting, the first of the Mare Nostrum circuit that also includes Barcelona and Le Canet in France.
The official reason given by his team was "the Russian champion has an ailment."
Pankratov is believed to be reserving himself for an attempt on his long-course 200 metres butterfly world record at Le Canet. He also holds the world record in the 100 metres butterfly.
